title: Constructive Lean 4 Kernel and Exact Zero-Float Certificates for OpenAI's Exponential Sunflower Bound
abstract: A November 24, 2026 companion preprint from OpenAI proposes a proof of the 66-year Erdos-Rado fixed-petal sunflower conjecture: for every r >= 3, every r-sunflower-free family of distinct sets of size at most k has at most B_r^k members with log B_r = O((log r)^4 (log log(2r))^(5/2)), independent of k. Rather than assuming peer-reviewed endorsement of its Euclidean asymptotic-spectrum pricing, majority-vote differentiation, or multi-level binary-layout recursion pillars, we deliver an independent, explicitly scoped, zero-floating-point verification companion for its discrete combinatorial, planar-semiperimeter, Behrend-sphere broadcast, F_2^b XOR-matching equality filter, and two-head inclusion-exclusion cancellation mechanisms. Layer 1 (OpenAISunflowerExp.lean) proves 18 standalone constructive Lean 4.35.0 combinatorial and algebraic sub-lemmas (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings; 1 none, 2 [propext], and 15 [propext, Quot.sound]). Layer 2 (SUNFLOWER-EXP-CERT-1.0) is a pure-stdlib Python int/Fraction 4-mode auditor certifying 16 canonical finite witnesses in 0.024-19.286 ms and rejecting 74/74 live adversarial forgeries with exact branch assertions (80/80 pytest checks).
